embedding: Frozen Clay v1.5 large; CLS concatenated with pooled patch token(s), 2048 dimensions
spatial_input: Full native 128x128 resized to 224x224; CLS plus centre pooled patch tokens; encoder spacing preserves the 1280 m footprint
caveat: Resizing preserves the native footprint; it does not add image detail. Time/location remain constant and training retains 2:1.
metadata_inputs: Time and latitude/longitude encodings held at all-zero constants for every image. No depth or other tabular predictors.
head: 2048 -> 512 ReLU dropout0.3 -> 128 ReLU dropout0.3 -> 1
training: All train rows, no resampling; focal alpha=.5 gamma=2; Adam lr=.001 weight_decay=.0001; batch64; max100epochs; patience25; no embedding scaling
selection: Checkpoint selected by validation macroF1 at .5; threshold selected by validation macroF1 over .05:.95 step.01; test evaluated only after selection
limitations: Exploratory dataset; selection and split balancing previously used full-pool covariates. Few independent ABSENT groups in held-out sets.
